patch.summary:
Choose Freshchat only if your buying job matches “Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 agent/mo ” rather than Zendesk Suite's shape. Choose Zendesk Suite only if your buying job matches “Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annual; Suite T” rather than Freshchat's shape. Workflow advantage: Freshchat leans live-chat-support; Zendesk Suite leans helpdesk-ticketing, omnichannel-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Freshchat is Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 agent/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Zendesk Suite is Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annual; Suite Team $55, Suite Pro $115..
- Company-size focus: Freshchat (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Zendesk Suite (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Freshchat-leaning live-chat-support vs Zendesk Suite-leaning helpdesk-ticketing, omnichannel-support.
- Researched limits: Freshchat — Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary; Zendesk Suite — Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams.

Limitations — Freshchat: Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary; Free plan limited to 10 agents; Zendesk Suite: Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams; Zendesk Sell (CRM) is a separate product — do not conflate slugs.

Poor-fit cases: Freshchat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary · Zendesk Suite is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams · Avoid Freshchat if you actually need Zendesk Suite's motion (Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annua)
